pages.title: Magic
pages.text: Two mods add magic to the pack. [#](2E5AAC)[Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks](entry://exploration/irons_spellbooks)[#]() is a full spellcasting system. [#](2E5AAC)[Create: Wizardry](entry://exploration/create_wizardry)[#]() bridges it to Create's machines with a new fluid, mana, and pipes to carry it.

Magic uses [#](7A3C9A)[mana](entry://glossary/mana)[#](), a resource that refills with time.\
\
Spells are cast from equipped spell books and scrolls, from schools such as fire, ice, lightning, holy, ender, blood, evocation and nature. Armor, rings and staffs boost them.

pages.title: Scroll
pages.text: A one-use spell. Made at a Scroll Forge, or found in loot.
